newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dec JGB closes firmer in Tokyo, cash bonds steady.
newsitem.headline: Dec JGB closes firmer in Tokyo, cash bonds steady.

text.p: The key December Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract closed firmer in Tokyo on Tuesday after having overcome dealers' interest in selling-on-recoveries.
"The market consensus since yesterday was 'selling-on-upticks' which was a natural market behavior after the recent aggressive advance," said a brokerage trader.
In line with such a consensus, the market was rife with speculation the Trust Fund Bureau of the Ministry of Finance would stop buying bonds from the market in December, traders said.
Traders said market players were taking a wait-and-see stance ahead of Japan's general elections on October 20.
"Investors will probably not move this week with the elections looming," said a city bank trader.
Traders said JGBs would probably not fall that much from current levels in the near term, since buying-on-dips demand for cash JGBs still remained.
There has been strong demand to sell put options in JGBs on the market downturn, suggesting strong portfolio interest by cash-rich institutional investors, a senior brokerage trader said.
